subject: AcmeHealth: private cluster patching cadence and rollback choreography
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@acmehealth.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Question: VPC private cluster patching cadence and pinning

Jordan —

We're lining up our month of November operations and wanted to align on how Redwood handles private (VPC) patching for our cluster. A few specific asks:

- We run a regulated workload, so we prefer version pinning with a staged upgrade rather than automatic rollouts. Is there an easy way to pin to a patch-train and schedule manual upgrades?
- Can you confirm maintenance window options (weekend vs weekday) and typical durations for a minor patch?
- What are the rollback triggers you recommend (metrics/alerts) and how quickly can we revert to the pinned version?

We'd like to propose a mid-November maintenance window the weekend of Nov 14–15. Can you share your recommended plan and any pre-checks you need from our side?

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Director, Platform Ops
AcmeHealth

Attachments: none
From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@acmehealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-01T11:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Question: VPC private cluster patching cadence and pinning

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the note. High-level answers below; I'll loop in Ops/Infra for the detailed runbook.

- Pinning/Upgrades: Yes — customers can pin to a specific minor/patch version in Private. We maintain a "pinned channel" per environment; upgrades are manual (you request a rollout) or can be scheduled by you via our Console.
- Windows: Typical minor patches take 45–120 minutes depending on KV-cache sizes and sequence-length distributions; for safety we recommend a 2-hour maintenance window. Weekends (Sat 02:00–06:00 local) are preferred for production.
- Rollback: Triggers we recommend: sustained >500ms tail latency for 30m, >2% error rate over baseline, or data-path failures (failed KV restore). Our rollback time to a pinned version is usually 15–30 minutes if snapshot/flagging is prepared.

I'll attach a draft maintenance matrix and a rollback playbook for your review. Neha + Markus — can you validate the timeline and whether the proposed weekend slot (Nov 14 02:00–04:00 ET) looks feasible for a canary + batch rollout? Also calling out network drain ordering (we prefer candidate nodes drained before routing shifts).

Next step: Elena, confirm the Nov 14 window or propose an alternative; we can run a smoke canary on a small subset first (5% of traffic).

Best,
Jordan
Head of Customer Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: acme_maintenance_matrix.xlsx, redwood_rollback_playbook_v1.md
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@acmehealth.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-01T14:22:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Question: VPC private cluster patching cadence and pinning

Adding some ops detail from the infra side. Short checklist: 

Pre-window (T-72h):
- Confirm backups/snapshots of model state and KV caches.
- Validate configuration pin exists in customer config (we will not unpin automatically).
- Health run: run load profile generator to simulate peak 75% traffic for 30m.

During window:
- Step 1: Canary deploy to a reserved node pool (5% traffic) — monitor token latency, generator-qa set.
- Step 2: Gradual drain + update remainder in 10–15 min batches. KV warmup / prefix-cache warming between batches.
- Step 3: Post-update regression checks: 99th percentile latency, total token cost delta, and 100-run eval set.

Rollback triggers & actions:
- Trigger: 99p latency > 2x baseline for 20m -> immediate rollback to pinned image.
- Action: Start rollback, re-route traffic to previously pinned pool, recover KV snapshot if needed. Target RTO 30m.

I attached a short network drain ordering doc (network_drain_steps.pdf) and the rollback playbook Jordan attached. For the Nov 14 slot — ops on-call (me + Priyom) are available. Markus, confirm that reserved node pool has capacity for the canary.

neha
Sr. Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: network_drain_steps.pdf, redwood_rollback_playbook_v1.md
From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@acmehealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-01T15:40:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Question: VPC private cluster patching cadence and pinning

Confirmed. We have capacity to hold a 5% canary and a rolling update in the reserved pool for Nov 14. A couple operational notes: 

- Version pin format: please confirm whether AcmeHealth wants pinning to "2.4.x" or strict "2.4.1". We recommend strict patch-level pins for regulated customers.
- DB / metadata migrations: if an agent-level DB migration is required, we must do a maintenance with DB freeze; that will extend window. Our assumption for this run is "safe" patch (no migrations).
- Observability hooks: we'll add a short-lived tracespan that flags when KV warmup completes; please provide the team's alerting contacts to add to the runbook.

If Elena confirms "strict patch pin" and Nov 14 window we'll lock the plan and schedule the pre-checks.

-Markus
VP Infrastructure, Redwood Inference
